item.title: Dubai’s property market remains resilient and has long-term gains for NRIs despite Iran crisis
item.description: Dubai’s residential real estate demand is not driven by tourism alone. The city’s large expatriate population and international investors continue to provide a stable base of housing demand

item.title: NRI mental health: Why awareness of self-harm should be more than for just a month
item.description: Most people engaging in acts of self-harm go to great lengths to try to hide it from those around them. Wearing long sleeves in very hot weather, making excuses for visible marks, limiting social interactions, and even avoiding outdoor activities communicate that self-injury isn’t a public performance, but a private battle

item.title: NRI updates: Indian national killed in Iranian attack on Kuwait power station
item.description: Confirming the death of the Indian worker, Ministry spokesperson Fatima Jawhar Hayat said that emergency response teams were assigned to the site soon after the strikes to manage the situation there

item.title: New Income Tax rule for UAE-based NRIs from April 1, 2026
item.description: NRIs applying for PAN card must submit many relevant documents, in addition to Aadhaar, following the removal of Aadhaar-only application method

item.title: NRI alert: CBSE launches alternative assessment scheme for Class XII students in the Middle East
item.description: Schools have been asked to submit scores from three internal assessments - the quarterly exam, the half-yearly exam and the pre-board exam. The highest score among these will be taken as the final result
